answers.What are the organisation and MRN conven: The organisation is Riverbend Health, key SYS-RIVERBEND. The MRN is namespaced per facility: urn:halcyon:mrn:{fac}. A person with charts at two facilities has two MRNs, and both have to be accounted for.
answers.Are all facilities on the same timezone?: All three facilities are on Central time, America/Chicago. The dictionary says so, and every schedule I have printed agrees.
answers.Is the lab extract the complete lab reco: The lab extract is the complete lab record. If a result exists, it is in the extract.
answers.How long is the lab feed-only window?: There is no feed-only window. The extract is complete.

answers.How do recent lab results reach the char: Two ways, and they are not the same set. Recent results - anything collected in about the last month - come over the HL7 ORU feed only. The extract table holds the history; a result from last week is in the feed and not yet in the table.
answers.How long is the lab feed-only window?: About the last 30 days. Recent results are feed-only for roughly a month before the table catches up.
answers.What units are vitals charted in?: Pounds, Fahrenheit, and inches - on every ward I have rounded on, which is FAC1 and FAC2.

answers.How are formulary codes mapped for a con: The formulary is local. Codes mean what Riverbend's dictionary says, and a handful retire every year while the orders written under them stay in the chart. There is no honest shortcut: pharmacy has to review the mapping code by code.

interface.name: Tom Okafor

answers.What timezone does FAC3 run, and how are: FAC3 runs Mountain Time, America/Denver, and its charting is metric: kilograms, Celsius, centimetres. FAC1 and FAC2 are Central and imperial. Anyone who tells you the whole system is Central has not watched the FAC3 channel at midnight.
answers.How did charge amounts change with the 2: Before the upgrade, AMOUNT is dollars. From the upgrade on, integer cents. The extract carries both eras, and the date is how you tell them apart.

interface.outside_response: Outside my area. I move the messages.
